summary.text: Arshia Papari is the Green Party candidate for Texas House District 49 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Montserrat Garibay in a race with no incumbent.
He is a University of Texas at Austin student and a Green Party co-chair.

paragraphs.text: Papari earned a high school diploma from Allen High School and, as of his 2026 campaign, attended the University of Texas at Austin.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a second-generation Iranian-American, a student of Government and Middle Eastern Studies, and the youngest National Co-Chair of the Green Party of the United States.
He advanced from the Green Party convention on March 14, 2026.
Papari listed three campaign messages in the survey: a rent freeze, ending corporate power, and protecting Texans' rights.
